## Milestone 1 - Task 5: Documentation Agent

Consumes the Decision Contract produced by 05-decision-orchestrator (docs/contracts/decision-contract.md) and produces a Report Contract (docs/contracts/report-contract.md) - the canonical, output-format-independent QA report record.

This workflow performs formatting only. It never invokes an AI model and never performs reasoning - every field in the Report Contract is either carried forward unchanged from the Decision Contract or derived from it with a fixed, deterministic template (string concatenation / lookup table), never generated. No Excel, Google Sheets, PDF, dashboard, or Jira logic exists anywhere in this file - those are downstream renderers that consume the Report Contract this workflow produces (Task 5.1+, not yet built).

## Design notes

- 'Route Validation Errors' mirrors the same-named pattern in every prior workflow: an item that's already an ERROR payload (upstream, or from 'Validate Contract') skips report-building entirely and passes straight through.
- 'Build Report Contract' is a single node because there is no branching logic left to do by this point - every value it needs was already validated/computed by the Decision Orchestrator. Splitting it into multiple nodes would not separate any distinct responsibility (see docs/workflow-standards.md's 'one job per node' - this one job is 'render the Decision Contract's already-final fields into report fields').
- `decision` in the Report Contract preserves the full verdict/decision_basis/request_id/response_id/decided_at from the Decision Contract unchanged, so a renderer or auditor can always trace a report row back to the exact decision it came from without re-deriving anything.
- `report.*` fields are the human/renderer-facing formatting layer: reused text (reasoning), reused structured data (evidence, joined - never re-summarized), and fixed per-status templates (tester_notes) - never freeform generation.

nodes.name: Report Renderers
nodes.notes: Hand-off boundary to future downstream renderers (Excel Writer - Task 5.1, PDF, Google Sheets, dashboards, Jira Agent) - none built yet. Every renderer consumes the same Report Contract (docs/contracts/report-contract.md) or an ERROR payload (docs/contracts/error-payload.md); this workflow has no opinion on, or knowledge of, any specific output format.
